The case of prosecution is that on 23.04.2019 on the receipt of DD no. 49-A regarding quarrel, SI Kamal Singh alongwith HC Rakesh reached at the spot i.e. B-186, Ekta Vihar, Jaitpur Extension, Part-I, New Delhi where they came to know that injured was shifted to the hospital and some public persons had already apprehended one person namely Mohd. Aslam at the spot. In the meantime, SI Kamal Singh received another DD no. 54A regarding the admission of injured Mohd. Yamin at Apollo hospital and he alongwith HC Rakesh reached there and collected his MLC as per which State vs Mohd.Aslam on 13 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36244305/ 1 doctor declared him fit for statement. Thereafter SI Kamal Singh recorded the statement of injured/ victim Sh. Mohd. Yamin wherein he stated that "a case was going on between him and accused Mohd. Aslam in the SDM Court which was fixed for today i.e. 23.04.2019; that he along with his son namely Mohd. Atif returned back to their bakery after the case hearing and his son Mohd. Kasif went went on his work; that he along with his son Mohd. Atif were present in their bakery and at about 06:30 PM, Mohd. Aslam and Mohd. Afsar came to their bakery on their scooty and started quareling with him and also threatened him and attacked him with a knife thereby causing injury in his head and neck ". On the statement of victim/ injured, the present FIR was registered against accused persons for the offence punishable u/s. 307/34 IPC against accused Mohd. Afsar and supplementary chargesheet was filed u/s 307/34 IPC and u/s 174 A IPC against accused Mohd. texts.facts: Ld. Addl. P.P. has argued that PW-3 Mohd. Yamin is the injured and eye witness of the case and he has fully supported the case of prosecution; that he not only disclosed the facts of the case but also disclosed the manner in which the injury was caused to him by the accused persons and also disclosed about the vital part of the body upon which injury was caused by the accused persons with the knife; that accused Mohd. Aslam was apprehended at the spot by the public persons and PW-3 identified both the accused persons before the Court; that the PW-4 Mohd. Atif who had made the call on 100 number immediately after happening of incident reached at the spot and had accompanied to PW-3 to the hospital and also supported the case of prosecution; that the injury of the PW-3 was proved by PW-3 as well as PW-4 and their testimonies are corroborated by medical evidence deposed by PW-8 and PW-9; that the there is no substantive contradiction and omissions are established by Ld. Defence Counsels in the testimony of PW-3 and the other witnesses of the case; that it is settled proposition of law that non recovery of weapon of offence does not diminish the case of prosecution if the case is established before the Court otherwise; that no motive has been established by the accused persons during the course of examination of the prosecution witnesses as to why both the accused persons have been falsely implicated in the present case; that the case of prosecution has been well established and hence accused persons should be convicted of the offence charged u/s 307/34 IPC.
texts.arguments: 8.1. Per contra, it was argued from the side of accused Mohd. Aslam that he has been falsely implicated in the present case by the complainant as he made a complaint against the complainant for running illegal bakery shop; that no weapon of offence was recovered during the entire investigation which shows that any injury was caused by him to the State vs Mohd.Aslam on 13 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36244305/ 7 victim; that the injury was caused by injured himself and later on he due to the previous enmity with the accused, he has been falsely implicated in the present case; that there are number of contradictions and omissions in the testimony of Prosecution witnesses therefore their testimonies are not reliable before this Court; that the prosecution is not able to prove its case beyond the reasonable doubt. In view of the same it has been prayed to this Court that accused Mohd. Aslam be acquitted of the offence punishable u/s 307/34 IPC. 8.2. It was argued from the side of accused Mohd. Afsar Ali that he has been falsely implicated in the present case by the complainant as initially when the PCR call was made, no allegation qua the present offence was intimated to the PCR officials by PW-4; that during the course of incident, he was not present at the place of incident; that no weapon of offence was recovered during the entire investigation which shows that no injury was caused to the injured during the course of alleged incident; that the injury was caused by injured himself and later on he due to the previous enmity with the accused, SC NO. 362/2019, FIR NO. 73/2019, PS. JATIPUR STATE VS. MOHD. ASLAM AND ANR. Digitally signed by GEETANJALI GEETANJALI Date: 2024.12.13 18:04:02 +0530 he has been falsely implicated in the present case; that there are number of contradictions and omissions in the testimony of Prosecution witnesses therefore their testimonies are not reliable before this Court; that the PO proceedings were falsely completed by the prosecution witnesses and no summon was served upon the accused during the entire proceedings; that the prosecution has not been able to prove his case beyond the reasonable doubt. In view of the same it has been prayed that accused Mohd. Afsar be acquitted of the offences punishable u/s 307/34 IPC and Section 174 A IPC. 9.

All the ingredients of section 307 IPC ought to be fulfilled before the conviction can be sustained under section 307 IPC.
The injuries sustained, the manner of assault and the weapon used are all relevant factors.
The foremost ingredients of section 307 IPC is the intention or knowledge which must precede the act attributed to the accused.

In order to determine the intention of the assailant various factors and circumstances are to be considered such as the nature of injury caused, severity of the blow or its persistence, sufficiency of time and opportunity of causing more in
The intention / knowledge has to be gathered from the surroundings circumstances and not necessarily from the results that follow, which may result in simple or grievous injury.
The onus lies on the prosecution that the accused has caused an act with intention/knowledge and under such circumstances that if by that act death was caused, he would be guilty of murder.
